fact: New create_v2 calls reject cashback enabled as true; false or an omitted argument creates the coin without cashback.
applicability: New coin creation after the documented cashback deprecation
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F031. Existing cashback coins are covered by a separate continuity rule. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The legacy create instruction records the name, symbol, URI and original creator in Metaplex metadata; the original creator may differ from the transaction user.
applicability: Legacy create; includes the free-creation flow in which the first buyer creates the coin on chain
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The Global authority can change curve initialization and fee parameters, and can transfer the Global authority role.
applicability: Pump Global configuration
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A regular coin may convert to holder rewards through a community takeover; once in holder-reward mode it stays in that mode.
applicability: Existing regular coins converted through the CTO process
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F044. Change type: documentation correction. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Pump.fun can globally disable new holder-reward coin creation; older instruction data continues to create regular coins.
applicability: create_v2 holder-reward option
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A new curve takes its virtual reserves, real token reserve and token supply from Global, while its real SOL reserve starts at zero.
applicability: Pump SOL bonding curves in the April 2025 specification
supplementary_information: Parameters in the documented Global example: virtual tokens 1,073,000,000,000,000 base units; virtual SOL 30,000,000,000 lamports; real tokens 793,100,000,000,000 base units; supply 1,000,000,000,000,000 base units. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The Mayhem description adds one billion agent tokens, giving two billion total tokens at creation, and burns the agent unsold balance after the first 24 hours.
applicability: Mayhem-enabled coins under the official page description
supplementary_information: Date basis: page-stated update 2025-11-12. Observed: 2026-10-30. Source section: How it works. Parameters: added supply 1,000,000,000 tokens; initial total 2,000,000,000 tokens; burn after 24 hours. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A new coin can be paired with a non-Mayhem Pump coin whose own quote is a listed asset; a quote coin already paired with another Pump coin is rejected in this version.
applicability: Unlisted Pump coins used as quote assets; quote curve active or already migrated; new coin is non-Mayhem
supplementary_information: A completed quote curve awaits migration before it can be used. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25. Next selected version: L4-F054 (2026-10-13).

fact: The October 13 document enables depth two, allowing a quote coin that is itself paired with a Pump coin; eligibility is checked along the entire quote chain.
applicability: Unlisted Pump-coin quote chains terminating in a listed asset; each curve active or migrated; Mayhem excluded
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F051. Officially stated start: 2026-10-13. Depth counts Pump-coin links above the listed quote asset. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The October 7 document derives starting virtual quote reserves from the quote coin current price on its curve or pool.
applicability: New coins paired with an unlisted Pump coin
supplementary_information: Version: price-based description. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25. Next selected version: L4-F053 (2026-10-08).

fact: The October 8 version simulates buying the quote coin with a normal launch raise, then scales the resulting quote-token amount into the new curve initial reserve.
applicability: New coins paired with an unlisted Pump coin; quote curve or pool read during creation
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F052. Version: raise-based derivation. Reference raise: about 85 SOL for a normal SOL launch. A seed rounded to zero is rejected. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25. Next selected version: L4-F055 (2026-10-13).

fact: For a nested quote, creation simulates a normal launch raise through each quote-chain curve or pool and scales the final quote-token output into the new curve initial reserve.
applicability: Depth-two Pump-coin quotes; live reserves read in the creation transaction
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F053. Version: raise-based derivation generalized to the quote chain. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The announced create_v2 interface uses Token-2022 for minting and metadata, with Mayhem chosen at creation; legacy create remains available and produces non-Mayhem coins.
applicability: Legacy create and new create_v2 at the November 2025 upgrade
supplementary_information: Scheduled start: 2025-11-11T12:00:00Z. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Pump prices bonding-curve trades using a Uniswap V2-based formula with virtual token and SOL reserves.
applicability: Pump SOL bonding curves in the April 2025 specification
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Curve v3 trades support SOL, USDC and Pump-coin quotes, including Mayhem; cashback coins continue through v2.
applicability: Pump buy_v3, buy_exact_quote_in_v3 and sell_v3
supplementary_information: Legacy and v2 trades remain supported and can coexist with v3 on an eligible coin. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Retaining protocol and creator fees subtracts the same amount from virtual quote reserves; paying them out adds it back, leaving effective trading liquidity unchanged.
applicability: PumpSwap v2 and multi-hop pool trades with deferred fees
supplementary_information: Formula: effective quote reserve = vault balance + virtual quote reserve. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Mayhem is selected at creation; its agent may buy and sell during the first 24 hours, without a guarantee of trading every eligible coin.
applicability: Coins that opt into Mayhem at creation
supplementary_information: Date basis: page-stated update 2025-11-12. Observed: 2026-10-30. Source section: How it works. Mode: experimental beta; trade directions described as equally likely. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A multi-hop swap executes an exact-input chain of buys or a chain of sells, with one final minimum-output check and no intermediate user token account.
applicability: Routes through eligible Pump curves and canonical PumpSwap pools; Mayhem excluded; cashback restricted to the user-currency end
supplementary_information: Parameter: min_amount_out > 0. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The PumpSwap admin can disable pool creation, liquidity deposits, withdrawals, buys or sells, and can update fee configuration.
applicability: Global PumpSwap administrative controls
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Pool buys and sells use the quote-vault balance plus virtual quote reserves; the base reserve remains the base-vault balance.
applicability: PumpSwap pools with the appended virtual_quote_reserves field
supplementary_information: Formula: effective_quote_reserves = quote_vault_balance + virtual_quote_reserves. The July document states the virtual value is zero at that time. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A liquidity deposit exchanges base and quote assets for LP tokens; withdrawal burns LP tokens to return base and quote assets under the supplied amount bounds.
applicability: PumpSwap deposit and withdraw
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: PumpSwap is a constant-product AMM; a pool creator sets its initial price through the initial base and quote deposits.
applicability: PumpSwap pool creation and trading
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: PumpSwap v2 trades cover canonical and permissionless pools, including Mayhem; cashback pools continue through the older interface.
applicability: PumpSwap buy_v2, buy_exact_quote_in_v2 and sell_v2
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A buy requests an exact token amount with a maximum SOL cost; a sell specifies an exact token amount with a minimum SOL receipt.
applicability: Legacy Pump buy and sell on SOL curves
supplementary_information: Units: SOL bounds are expressed in lamports. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The announcement permits negative virtual quote reserves from September 30 while preserving a nonnegative effective quote reserve within u64 range.
applicability: PumpSwap pool pricing with signed i128 virtual_quote_reserves
supplementary_information: Officially stated start: 2026-09-30. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The new v2 curve interface supports quote-asset-aware trading while keeping native SOL settlement for SOL pairs and retaining legacy trading support.
applicability: Pump buy_v2, sell_v2 and buy_exact_quote_in_v2
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A buy sets complete to true when the real token reserve reaches zero.
applicability: Pump bonding curve; condition checked at the end of a buy
supplementary_information: Condition: real_token_reserves = 0. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Pump burns the LP tokens received when bonding-curve liquidity is migrated to PumpSwap.
applicability: Liquidity created through the Pump migration flow
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Any user can migrate a completed curve to PumpSwap; repeating migrate after successful migration has no additional effect.
applicability: Pump migrate; complete = true and real_token_reserves = 0
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: An eligible final v3 buy first empties the curve, then buys from the assets destined for its future PumpSwap pool using constant-product pricing; migration creates the pool from the remaining reserves.
applicability: Final buy_v3 or buy_exact_quote_in_v3 on a non-Mayhem curve
supplementary_information: Fee rule: both parts use bonding-curve fees. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Synthetic pricing uses the remaining base tokens and raised quote assets; SOL pairs subtract Global.pool_migration_fee, while token-quoted pairs use the raised quote without that subtraction.
applicability: Reserves used for the pool portion of the final eligible buy
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: After the completing buy, curve buys and sells fail until migration; legacy and v2 buys retain their earlier amount limits, and Mayhem retains its partial-fill behavior.
applicability: Completed curves; instruction-specific final-buy rules
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The attached schedule assigns the bonding curve a 1.25% total fee, split into 0.30% creator and 0.95% protocol fees; canonical pool totals vary by SOL-denominated market-cap tier.
applicability: Fee schedule attached to the August 2025 dynamic-fee announcement
supplementary_information: Schedule endpoints: pool market cap below 420 SOL totals 1.25%; at least 98,240 SOL totals 0.30%. Intermediate tiers are in the cited schedule image. The image rounds some displayed totals. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Non-completed curves accrue creator fees on swaps after the creator-fee upgrade and a nonzero Global creator-fee rate.
applicability: Pump curves that remain open for trading
supplementary_information: Activation condition: deployed upgrade and creator_fee_basis_points > 0. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: With FeeConfig present, the curve chooses protocol and creator rates from the market-cap tiers; otherwise it uses the corresponding Global rates.
applicability: Pump bonding curves covered by the announced dynamic-fee upgrade
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F014. Scheduled start: 2025-09-01T20:00:00Z. Market cap in lamports = virtual SOL reserves × mint supply / virtual token reserves. Tier rule: highest threshold at or below market cap; first tier below the first threshold. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Cashback redirects the creator-fee component to the trader on eligible volume; legacy sell and PumpSwap flows require their cashback accounts to be supplied.
applicability: Cashback-enabled coins and the instruction-specific account conditions
supplementary_information: Bonding-curve buys handle cashback automatically; required sell and AMM cashback accounts are listed in the cited passage. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Bonding-curve cashback is withdrawn as native SOL from the user accumulator; PumpSwap cashback is withdrawn as WSOL into the user token account.
applicability: Claiming accrued cashback on the two programs
supplementary_information: Units: native lamports on Pump; wrapped SOL on PumpSwap. The user WSOL account must already exist for the AMM claim. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Pending creator fees are swept before creator collection, shareholder distribution or a change of creator.
applicability: New deferred-fee trades followed by creator payout or reassignment
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: New coins use the supplied creator address; older coins obtain the fee recipient from Metaplex creator metadata or the platform record through creator-setting instructions.
applicability: Pump creator-fee upgrade; new and existing curves
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Coins paired with assets other than SOL or USDC may have a custom creator-fee rate; SOL and USDC pairs use the standard schedule.
applicability: Custom quote pairs; existing-rate changes handled through the CTO team
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: New curve v3 and PumpSwap v2 trades retain protocol and creator fees for later sweeps; buyback fees are paid during the trade and pool LP fees enter reserves immediately.
applicability: Pump v3, PumpSwap v2 and multi-hop; old interfaces keep per-trade payouts
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Existing cashback coins retain their cashback trading behavior and their accrued cashback remains claimable.
applicability: Coins created with cashback before new cashback creation was deprecated
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Trade events record charged fees, while separate sweep events record later payouts from protocol or creator buckets.
applicability: Pump v3 and PumpSwap v2 fee accounting
supplementary_information: Accounting: treat accrual and payout as two stages of the same fee. Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The creator or authorized global admin can enroll a coin in fee sharing; the initial allocation gives the creator all 10,000 basis points.
applicability: Coins enrolled through create_fee_sharing_config
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The reward distribution can be configured once, after which it is locked; distributions predating the policy are also treated as final.
applicability: Creator reward sharing under the March 2026 policy
supplementary_information: Trading instructions are unchanged by this policy. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A final shareholder list has one to ten distinct recipients, positive shares and a total of 10,000 basis points; applying it revokes further admin updates.
applicability: update_fee_shares_v2 for eligible sharing configurations
supplementary_information: Parameters: maximum 10 recipients; shares sum to 100%. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Holder-reward coins reserve creator fees for holders, with ongoing payouts operated by Pump.fun and no holder claim instruction.
applicability: Coins created in holder-reward mode
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The official description directs Mayhem-coin protocol fees to an agent insurance fund and exempts the Mayhem agent from Pump protocol fees.
applicability: Mayhem agent and protocol fees under the dated official description
supplementary_information: Date basis: page-stated update 2025-11-12. Observed: 2026-10-30. Source section: Mayhem Mode revenue & funding. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Mayhem-mode trades may use any configured reserved Mayhem recipient.
applicability: Pump and PumpSwap coins with is_mayhem_mode = true
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F029. Documentation change: one recipient expanded to the configured recipient set. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: A route charges the protocol fee at the user-currency end and creator or holder fees, plus any LP fee, at the target-coin end; intermediate hops charge none.
applicability: multi_hop_swap route; rates follow the fee-charging venue
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Anyone may sweep pending fees to the predetermined recipients; curve fees remain sweepable after migration.
applicability: Protocol and creator fee buckets held on curves or pools
supplementary_information: Window: document update within window; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The upgrade adds creator fees to canonical PumpSwap pools created through Pump migration, alongside LP and protocol fees.
applicability: Canonical PumpSwap pools; upgrade deployed and creator-fee rate nonzero
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: With FeeConfig present, canonical Pump pools use market-cap tiers and other pools use flatFees; absent FeeConfig, GlobalConfig rates apply.
applicability: PumpSwap pools under the announced dynamic-fee upgrade
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F018. Scheduled start: 2025-09-01T20:00:00Z. Pool market cap in lamports = quote reserve × base mint supply / base reserve. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Anyone can transfer AMM creator fees into the curve creator vault and distribute that vault to shareholders according to their basis-point shares.
applicability: Coins with an active sharing_config; SOL paid as lamports and other quotes as tokens
supplementary_information: Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: Anyone may call the v2 curve and AMM collection instructions to pay the designated creator; curve and AMM fees occupy separate vaults.
applicability: Single-creator coins without sharing_config; collect_creator_fee_v2 and collect_coin_creator_fee
supplementary_information: Previous record: L4-F023. The legacy signature-based collection interface is a separate instruction version. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.

fact: The social-fee flow supports individual GitHub users, whose linked vault fees are claimed through Pump.fun web or mobile.
applicability: GitHub social recipients; recipient PDA initialized before allocation
supplementary_information: Eligibility: individual GitHub accounts; organizations are excluded. Window: baseline document; 2026-10-01 <= UTC date < 2026-10-25.
